codec.layout: block_nvfp4 d[4] then qs[32], QK64. Four independent groups of16. In subgroup g, qs[g*8+j] low nibble is logicalg*16+j, high nibble is +8, j0..7. Preserve original encoded rows/expert offsets (rowbytes=K/64*36), no repack.
codec.scale: Match pinned ggml_ue4m3_to_fp32 exactly, accounting for its returned half-scale with doubled integer E2M1 table. The existing Metal LUT is actual E2M1, so a Metal scale helper used with it must return FULL UE4M3. Preserve byte0/0x7f ->+0 and source exponent/mantissa behavior; do not borrow MLX E4M3FN interpretation or mask bytes to another contract.
codec.decoder_tile16: dequantize_nvfp4(block, il0..3, float4x4/half4x4&) reads scale d[il] and logical16 subgroup in contiguous order (first8low, second8high). Generic MM nl=4 naturally advances il0/1 then2/3 over two NK32 iterations; GetRows ind/4 and ind%4 are already correct for block64.
codec.decoder_tile4: dequantize_nvfp4_t4(block, il0..15, float4&) uses group=il/4 and chunk=il%4; chunks0/1 select low nibbles of four bytes, chunks2/3 high nibbles of the same eight bytes. This reuses existing generic q4 float4 carrier with chpb16.

numeric_source_domain_proof.method: Exhaustive source-formula F32-bit vs IEEE half roundtrip on2048 constants, not a Metal/backend test. Weight products have <=8 significant integer bits, so assigning decoded weights to half tile adds no value rounding in this legal domain.
numeric_source_domain_proof.limits: Signedzero in actual Metal fast-math code still requires compiled GetRows witness; full GPU/backend equivalence is not established. Match original helper for raw byte behavior rather than silently aliasing other FP8 codecs.
